So `getFieldValue(GreChecksumOrRouting, true)` returns `m_Data + sizeof(gre_basic_header)` if neither checksumBit nor routingBit is set. `gre_basic_header` is 4 bytes. So `offset = 4`. Writing 2 bytes at offset 4 is within bounds if the GRE layer has at least 6 bytes.
